_comment: Editorial content for FECTC. Every fact is attributable — see sourceNote. Add imagePath/imageSource/imageLicence together when a real one is available.
description: Fecto Cement Limited was established in 1981 and began production on 1 January 1990. Its plant at Sangjani, near Islamabad, is described by the company as Pakistan's first anti-pollution cement plant and the first of its kind in South Asia, with a rated capacity of 780,000 tonnes of clinker a year; the plant was erected by Fuller International of the United States. Fecto Cement is the listed cement company of the Fecto group.
